source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Run MLPerf v5.0 Mixtral-8x7B Offline and compare with MLCommons v5.0.
procedure_facts: Source says training_results_v5.0 but runs inference-style Mixtral Offline.
No MoE/expert, precision, tokenizer/prompt or exact accuracy profile is supplied.
criteria_facts: MLPerf inference runs without error and score is compared with MLCommons.
source_conflicts: training_results conflicts with the inference command and criteria.
missing_source_information: Model accuracy, Offline metric, compliance and comparable result/tolerance.

original_test_intent.statement: Run MLPerf Inference v5.0 Mixtral-8x7B Offline, prove model-specific accuracy and LoadGen/compliance validity, and compare valid Offline throughput with a comparable v5.0 result.
must_preserve: Mixture-of-experts model identity and valid throughput.
must_not_infer: MLPerf Training, Server, another Mixtral variant or generic MoE settings.
Official/comparable status from a generic score.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 detects training/inference conflict and requires Mixtral model/MoE identity, v5.0 Offline artifacts and LoadGen validity.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not explicitly bind tokenizer/prompt/expert routing and output policy, Offline metric semantics or the comparison to a named equivalent result.

related_records: Llama and GPT-J artifacts/accuracy cannot satisfy Mixtral MoE identity.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Correct training/inference and pin the Mixtral-8x7B model, MoE/tokenizer profile, v5.0 Offline rules and comparable result before execution.

conditions_present: Model, scenario and release are stated.
missing: Correct source, artifacts/configs, accuracy/metric/compliance, reference and limits.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory GPU/fabric/runtime/storage and inspect v5.0 Mixtral metadata.
prohibited_until_resolved: Download/run/tune, use training artifacts, clear logs or PASS.
closure_evidence: Inference correction, pinned MoE stack and named comparable Offline rule.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v5.0 Mixtral-8x7B Offline
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v5.0 Mixtral-8x7B Offline configuration, verify model-specific accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure valid Offline throughput, and compare only with a signed comparable v5.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact multi-GPU SUT/fabric, driver/runtime, v5.0 inference harness/container, Mixtral-8x7B weights/expert configuration/tokenizer/evaluation data and configs.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Mixtral-8x7B Offline across declared resources. Server, Training and other MoE/model variants are excluded. 240/60 minutes are planning metadata.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected source; pinned stack; licensed weights/tokenizer/data hashes; expert/routing, precision, batching and prompt/output policy; configs; accuracy/performance/compliance procedures; Offline metric; comparable result ID; tuning/fabric/health limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify model/expert/tokenizer/config identity and baseline health, then run accuracy, Offline performance and required compliance with the pinned v5.0 inference implementation. Preserve model-validity, LoadGen and GPU/fabric evidence; do not use training_results.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflict corrected; artifacts licensed/pinned; GPUs/fabric healthy; capacity/tuning/load/recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU/fabric identity; all artifact/config hashes; MoE/expert/tokenizer/prompt manifest; exact commands; model accuracy; complete LoadGen Offline metric/validity; compliance; HBM/XID/ECC/fabric/power/thermal/host logs; named result/comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v5.0 Mixtral-8x7B Offline rules and comparable result. Pass requires model accuracy, valid LoadGen/compliance, the correct Offline metric meeting the numeric rule and clean health.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix training/inference, models/scenarios/releases; change expert/tokenizer/prompts/tuning without approval; use unlicensed artifacts; clear logs; suppress invalidity or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/platform owners approve identity/artifacts/reference/load; human judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans correct source/reference; Agent runs frozen inference workflow only.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity/limits, preserve evidence, terminate cleanly, restore state and verify GPUs/fabric/host.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Conflict/reference unresolved; wrong model/scenario/release; missing license/config; accuracy/LoadGen/compliance failure; topology/HBM/storage/XID/ECC/link/thermal/power/host limit; evidence loss.
